findings.verbatim: Remediation of TA2-HI-01 changed "इसे किसी व्यक्ति ने दिया" to "इसे किसी व्यक्ति ने दी". With the object marked by को (इसे = इस को), a perfective ergative verb takes default masculine singular, so "इसे ... ने दी" is an agreement error; feminine agreement with स्वीकृति requires an unmarked object ("यह ... ने दी"). The inability to prove a person approved remains clear; the glossary term स्वीकृति is correct.
findings.recommendation: "…इसलिए यह स्वीकृति साबित नहीं कर सकती कि यह किसी व्यक्ति ने दी।" (or revert to "इसे … ने दिया").
findings.disposition: not applied: auditors never edit translations; handed to the implementer for one batched remediation or explicit deferral. Nonblocking: no security-consent consequence is reversed or omitted.
